rule.description: A contiguous group of bare parameter types that recurs across four or more function/method signatures in two or more source files, indicating a cohesive set of values threaded by hand through many call sites instead of being encapsulated once behind a single abstraction.

checks.description: Finds a contiguous window of normalized parameter types (>= 4) that recurs in >= 4 distinct signatures across >= 2 files, and reports every signature that contains it as a data-clump carrier.
checks.detected_relation: carrier signature -> shared recurring bare-parameter group (name, version, repo, target, pkg meta, template values)
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The same cohesive pack of fetcher-construction facts is passed element-by-element down through the trait method, both concrete fetcher constructors, the orchestration helper, the bin-collection helper, and the bin-file constructor instead of being carried as one value, so callers and signature changes must track every element in lockstep.

matches.evidence: Trait declaration threads the group [name, version, repo, target, meta, target_related_info, repo_info_cache, signature_policy] (plus client and gh_api_client) as ten bare parameters; its 6-type window [STR, STR, OPT<STR>, STR, PkgMeta, DYN<Values>] recurs with support 6 across 5 files.
Constructor for the GitHub-crate-meta fetcher takes the same ten-parameter group verbatim, duplicating the trait contract element-by-element instead of receiving one fetcher-construction value.
QuickInstall constructor carries the identical ten-parameter group (several kept only to satisfy the shared contract) so every constructor repeats the same element list.
Orchestration helper forwards the whole construction group plus a resolver-predicate and handle list through twelve bare parameters, eldest element first, reproducing the recurring window verbatim.

Bin-collection helper receives [name, version, repo, target, meta, target_related_info] followed by package/path/no_symlinks state as eleven bare parameters, re-threading the same six-type group before delegating to the bin-file constructor.

BinFile constructor takes [name, version, repo, target, meta, target_related_info] plus bin_path/install_path/template/no_symlinks as eleven bare parameters, making the same six-type group the spine of a fourth, unrelated call site.

excluded.reason: resolve accepts (repo, cache, client): three parameters that never recur as a group elsewhere, so it is below the support threshold and is not a carrier.
